column3: About dialog body: sets tool-window flags, fills version/compiled labels from APP_VERSION/REVNO/BUILDDATE macros and the :/simulide.png icon.
Declares AboutDialog as a QDialog with a private Ui::AboutDialog mixin; constructor only.
Qt Designer form for AboutDialog: version/compiled labels, website link, and a QTabWidget with Contributors and Translations tabs (read via widget inventory, not line by line).

Settings dialog logic: reads/writes Circuit, Simulator and MainWindow singletons; converts between steps-per-second and ps-per-second with an m_blocked re-entrancy guard (updtSpeed/updtSpeedPer) and derives the AnalogClock react step from its divider.
Declares the three-tab Settings dialog (App/Circuit/Simulation) and every on_XXX_changed slot; holds the speed conversion state (m_stepsPS, m_stepSize, m_psPerSec, m_blocked).

Designer form for the Settings dialog: tabList with appTab/circTab/simTab, language/theme/font combos, canvas size spinners, fps, undo steps, speed slider plus step-size boxes and units (read via widget inventory).
Current-speed slider widget; maps slider 0..1000 to a current via pow(speed/150, 4.5) so low speeds are finely controllable; hidden by default.
Declares CurrentWidget with a static self() singleton and a speed() accessor; the showCurrentWidget() toggle is commented out.
Designer form: one 'Current Speed:' QLabel plus a horizontal QSlider (min 1, max 1000, value 500) with ticks both sides.

Live simulation telemetry panel: formats simulated time down to ps, renders real speed %, engine load, GUI load, FPS, and shows the main MCU device/frequency; rate<0 is a sentinel meaning -1 Debugger / other Circuit ERROR.
Declares InfoWidget's setters setRate/setCircTime/setTargetSpeed/updtMcu over a private Ui::infoWidget mixin.
Designer form: labels for Simulation Time, Target/Real Speed, Engine Load, Update Load, Real FPS, GUI overload and Main MCU (read via widget inventory).

Core of the canvas: Circuit is a QGraphicsScene that owns components/connectors/nodes, loads and saves the .sim2 text format, implements undo/redo as serialized-state diffs, draws the grid, and handles canvas keyboard shortcuts.
Header for the Circuit scene: declares the component/connector/node registries, the compChange/circChange undo structures, the property-name/pin/component maps, and the load/save/undo/redo API.

QGraphicsView wrapper: zoom-to-fit, rubber-band and pan modes, drag-and-drop of components from the palette, copy-by-drag (Ctrl+Shift), context menu with Paste/Undo/Redo/Import/Save-as-image, and SVG or PNG export of the scene.
Header for CircuitView: declares zoom slots, drag/drop overrides, the scale factor and the scrollbar-policy toggle.

Main GUI panel: builds the toolbar/splitters, hosts CircuitView + OutPanelText + InfoWidget + CurrentWidget, drives Simulator start/stop/pause/debug, keeps the recent-circuit list in QSettings, and colour-codes the status message label.
Header for the CircuitWidget panel: declares the power/pause/debug API, the recent-file action array and the signals the rest of the app connects to.

CompBase holds the property groups that define a component's identity: loadProperties applies them in file order, setPropStr/getPropStr look up a ComProperty, and toString() serialises the whole group set to one <item .../> line.
Declares the propGroup struct (name, propList, groupHidden/groupNoCopy flags) and CompBase's property-group registry; groupNoCopy marks properties that must not be copied into a subcircuit.

ConnBase is the graphical+electrical base for multi-pin connectors: it creates/destroys paired connector and socket pins, registers them with an eNode, and stops the simulation whenever the pin count changes.
Declares ConnBase's pin vectors (m_connPins/m_sockPins), pin type and the createPins/deletePins/updatePins hooks.

Connector is the wire: owns an ordered list of ConnectorLines, computes the Manhattan route with automatic corner insertion and null-line removal, exposes pointList for serialisation, and drives the current animation from getCurrent().
Header for Connector: declares the point list, line list, splitCon (wire splitting at a Node) and the current-animation fields.

One straight segment of a wire: paints the line (bus green, logic high/low red/blue, current dots when animating), handles corner dragging and connecting a new wire to an existing one by splitting it at a Node.
Declares ConnectorLine's two endpoints, prev/next links, the diagonal test, and the QGraphicsItem::UserType+2 type tag.
Dialed component: hosts a DialWidget proxy on the canvas, maps the 0..1000 knob to a min/max value with optional step rounding, and drives the component from the dial.
Declares the Dialed component's value/min/max/step API and its proxy-widget member.

IoPin is the electrically live pin: manages input/open-collector/output/source modes with their admitances, ramps the output over m_steps via Simulator events, and registers its API with the AngelScript engine.
Declares IoPin's electrical state (in/out voltages, admitances, impedances, rise/fall times) and the pinMode_t enum.
IoPort groups a set of IoPins behind a bit-mask state: setOutState/setDirection only touch the pins whose bits actually changed, and addSequence/trigger drive a timed output waveform.
Declares IoPort's vector of IoPin pointers, the per-port output sequence vectors, and its AngelScript registration entry point.
Label is a free text annotation attached to a component: it drags itself, rotates in 90 degree steps, and recomputes its position so it stays upright under component flips.
Declares the Label QGraphicsTextItem with rotation, flip-aware positioning and rotateCW/CCW/180 slots.

Pin is the QGraphicsItem on a component: carries the electrical state enum, registers itself with the Circuit pin map, auto-connects to a nearby pin when Shift is held, and paints the state colour plus input/output arrows.
Declares the 8-value pinState_t enum (undef, driven_low, open_low/high, out_low/high, input_low/high), the pin type enum and the Pin's label/mirror fields.
Updatable's destructor removes the object from the Simulator update list, so per-step callbacks cannot outlive the widget.
Declares the 15-line Updatable mixin: a constructor, a destructor and one virtual updateStep() with an empty default body; no members and no QObject base.

The component palette: loads component sets from XML files and from the installed-library registry, builds the categorized tree, supports search, drag-to-canvas via a name,type MIME payload, per-component keyboard shortcuts and persists the tree layout to compList.xml.
Header for the palette: declares the component/category maps, the shortcut map, the item library member and the XML loading hooks.
Downloads component-set zips from simulide.com, extracts them with qZipReader into the components directory and reloads the palette; it also tracks installed versions and dependencies.
Declares the Installer widget: checkForUpdates/installItem/unInstallItem over a QNetworkAccessManager, with maps of installed items and versions.
Designer form: a 'Check for Updates' push button above a single-column QTableWidget used as the component-set list.
Fills the info dialog with the component-set title, author and the list of items the set contributes.
Declares the InstallInfo dialog (no Q_OBJECT; it is a plain QDialog over ui_installinfo.h).
Designer form for the set-info popup: two MarkdownText QLabels (tittleLabel, authorLabel) and a selectable-but-not-editable QTextEdit (listEdit) holding the component list.
One row of the installer table: parses the ';'-separated set descriptor (name, description, file, version, dependency, author), and paints its own Install/Update/Uninstall button state and colours.
Declares InstallItem's button state enum (bInstall/bUpdate/bUninstall) and its descriptor fields.
Designer form: a frameless QTextEdit for the set name, a second QTextEdit for the description and three 22x22 tool buttons (info, install, update).

The component registry: ~130 LibraryItem entries in category order, each pointing at the component class's own libraryItem() factory, plus createItem() which dispatches a type string to the right factory.
Declares LibraryItem (name, category, icon, comma-separated type list, createItemPtr factory) and the ItemLibrary registry with a static self().
Shortcut manager dialog: flattens the component tree into a two-column table and writes the single-character shortcut back into the tree item and the ComponentList shortcut map.
Declares manCompDialog and its two QMap<QTableWidgetItem*,TreeItem*> back-references used to resolve edited table rows to tree items.
Designer form: a single two-column QTableWidget titled 'Component Shortcuts'.

Vendored copy of Qt's private qZipReader (Nokia, LGPL) - 580 lines of upstream zip-extraction code; read the first 120 lines to confirm the provenance, not line by line because nothing in it is SimulIDE logic.
Vendored Nokia/Qt LGPL header for qZipReader: public API (fileInfoList, fileData, extractAll, status) plus the private d-pointer.

TreeItem is the palette row: it applies the per-category font/colour scheme, can be inverted for the dark theme, and serialises the whole tree to XML (category/component elements with expanded and shortcut attributes).
Declares TreeItem plus the treItemType_t enum (type_NONE, component, categ_MAIN, categ_CHILD) used to switch row styling and flags.
CustomButton paints a rounded, gradient-filled QToolButton (pressed state inverted) instead of using the native style.
Declares CustomButton, a QToolButton with an overridden paintEvent.
CustomDial repaints a QDial from scratch: notches, knob ellipse and a focus glow, and installs an event filter so a click only grabs the knob when it is within 5 px of the pointer.
Declares CustomDial with the cached knob arrow position (m_arrowX/m_arrowY) used by the hit-test event filter.
CustomSlider repaints a QSlider as a small green/grey rail with a gradient knob, arrow triangles and either coarse or per-step notches.
Declares CustomSlider, a fixed 60x14 horizontal QSlider with a custom paintEvent.

DataChannel owns one captured trace: it buffers (time,value) samples, and doTest() compares a live trace against a stored golden trace with a 0.1% tolerance and exact timestamps, and can serialise the trace to/from text.
Declares the cond_t enum (C_NONE, C_LOW, C_RISING, C_HIGH, C_FALLING) and the DataChannel sample buffers plus edge/period tracking state.
Logic-analyser panel header: eight channel name fields whose text is pushed back into PlotBase::channelChanged, and an Expand button that toggles the expanded view.
Declares DataLaWidget over ui_datalawidget.h with per-channel colour and tunnel setters and an event filter that deselects the component when a field takes focus.
Designer form: eight QLineEdit channel fields plus a CustomButton 'Expand' (read via widget inventory).
Oscilloscope panel header: four channel name fields plus per-channel frequency readouts, all pushed back into the Oscope component.
Declares DataWidget over ui_datawidget.h with setColor/setData/setTunnel and the four per-channel slots.
Designer form: four QLabel frequency fields, four QLineEdit channel fields and a CustomButton 'Expand' (read via widget inventory).

Logic-analyser control dialog: time division and position dials/boxes with unit-aware conversion, per-channel bus flags, rising/falling thresholds, a trigger channel and a condition editor that calls the analyser's updateConds.
Declares LaWidget's action enum (actNone/actMove/actTime) for mouse panning and the PlotDisplay accessor.

Designer form: a native PlotDisplay plus trigger combo, condition edit, export button, time division/position dials and PlotSpinBoxes, eight bus radio buttons and threshold spin boxes (read via widget inventory).

Oscilloscope control dialog: per-channel time/voltage division and position, an auto-scale channel selector, trigger and hide radio groups, track count, a filter spin box and mouse-drag panning of the time base.
Declares OscWidget's action enum and the update*Box methods that mirror analyser state into the UI without feedback loops.
Designer form: native PlotDisplay, five channel buttons, four dial/PlotSpinBox pairs for time and voltage, filter box and auto/trigger/hide/track radio groups (read via widget inventory).

PlotBase is the shared base of the oscilloscope and logic analyser: it owns up to 8 DataChannels, registers its condition variables with the AngelScript engine, compiles a user condition string into a pause() script, and runs a timed self-test that reports to BatchTest.
Declares PlotBase's channel array, per-channel condition variables, buffer sizes and the abstract timDiv/volDiv/trigger interface the subclasses implement.

The waveform renderer: draws the graticule, reads the ring buffers backwards from the trigger index, sub-samples points closer than 0.5 px into a min/max envelope, draws buses as two rails with a hex value, and renders the cursor readouts.
Declares PlotDisplay's per-channel scale/position/limit arrays, the buffer pointers it borrows from each DataChannel, and the graticule geometry.
PlotSpinBox is a QDoubleSpinBox whose validator strips an SI prefix letter (p/n/u/m/k/M/G) from the typed text and turns it into the spinbox suffix.
Declares PlotSpinBox with setUnitStr() and a validate() override.
DialWidget hosts either a CustomDial knob or a CustomSlider and swaps between them at runtime via setType(), keeping the two in sync.
Declares DialWidget's dual dial/slider members and the abstract-slider accessor the components connect to.

BaseDebugger maps flash addresses to source lines by parsing the compiler's .lst file (with separate asm and high-level strategies), tracks function entry addresses for step-over, and drives single-stepping of the simulated CPU.
Declares codeLine_t (file + line, comparable) and BaseDebugger's flash-to-source map, function table and step-over state.

CodeEditor is the QPlainTextEdit at the heart of the code editor: it detects the file type from its extension, picks a syntax file and a debugger, auto-completes with a QCompleter fed from the toolchain, paints breakpoint/error/warning markers in the gutter, and shifts those line numbers when text is inserted or deleted.

Declares CodeEditor over CompBase (so the editor itself is a saveable object with properties), the LineNumberArea helper class and the static per-architecture instruction lists used for dialect detection.

Compiler is the generic build driver: it loads an XML compiler definition, substitutes $filePath/$device/$family-style tokens, runs each build step as a QProcess, parses the toolchain's error and warning output back into line numbers, and stores the tool path in QSettings.
Declares Compiler's build-step lists (command/arguments/argsDebug), the file/project fields and the virtual compile()/preProcess()/postProcess() hooks the per-toolchain debuggers override.

asDebugger is the AngelScript toolchain: it compiles the script inside the simulated ScriptCpu, uploads the script source as the firmware, and reports script errors/warnings back to the editor's gutter.
Declares asDebugger's upload()/compile() overrides and its ScriptCpu pointer.

AvrGccDebugger drives avr-gcc tooling: it runs avr-objdump/avr-readelf/avr-size/avr-addr2line to extract variable addresses, function entry points and the flash-address-to-source-line map, and forces a C locale so the tool output parses.
Declares AvrGccDebugger's ELF path, address byte width and the three extraction steps (variables, functions, flash mapping).
cDebugger pre-scans the C sources to build a variable-name-to-type table so the debugger can show types, and collects every .c/.cpp/.h/.hpp in the folder as project files.
Declares cDebugger as a BaseDebugger whose only override is preProcess().

GcbDebugger handles GcBasic: it parses the .gcb source for DIM declarations (including arrays), walks the generated .asm for variable EQU addresses and the .lst for the flash map, and reads subroutines from the .report.txt.
Declares GcbDebugger's error-line override, postProcess() and the two private helpers getSubs()/mapFlashToSource().
GputilsDebug is a static helper that drives the gputils gpvc tool for PIC targets: it reads the .cod symbol table for variables and the .line directives for the flash-to-source map.
Declares GputilsDebug's two static entry points getVariables() and mapFlashToSource(), both taking a BaseDebugger.

InoDebugger wraps the Arduino toolchain in both its generations (arduino-builder and arduino-cli): it detects the version, locates the AVR toolchain and board list, builds the sketch with a separate build/cache folder, and injects the whole Arduino API into the editor's completion and highlighting.
Declares InoDebugger's board/custom-board fields, its toolPath override and its compile/upload/postProcess overrides.

SdccDebugger wraps SDCC: it converts the .ihx to .hex with packihx, finds the CSEG base address in the .map file, and maps flash to source either through the PIC gputils path or through the SDCC .lst format.
Declares SdccDebugger's compile() override (ihx to hex conversion) and the private findCSEG() helper.
Xc8Debugger is AvrGccDebugger with a two-byte address width, for the MPLAB XC8 toolchain.
Declares Xc8Debugger as a subclass of AvrGccDebugger with no new members.

Find/replace bar for the code editor: forward and backward search, whole-word/case/regexp flags, highlight-all and replace-all, each reporting the occurrence count through the editor's message channel.
Declares FindReplace over ui_findreplace.h with the editor pointer and a private find(bool next) helper.
Designer form: find and replace line edits, next/prev/all/replace/replace-and-find/replace-all buttons and three check boxes (whole, case, regexp) - read via widget inventory.
DocPage is the per-tab container: it stacks the CodeEditor under a red bar that appears when the file changes on disk, offering Reload / Keep Current / Close Tab / Keep Open.
Declares DocPage's change-bar widgets and the showModifiedBar/showDeletedBar/hideChangeBar slots.

EditorWidget is the multi-tab code editor: file open/save/reload, recent files, a QFileSystemWatcher that detects on-disk changes and re-arms itself, per-editor font/tab/space settings, the find-replace bar and the compile/debug toolbars.
Declares EditorWidget's settings API (font size, tab size, show spaces, auto-close pairs), the file-hash to page map and the virtual debug/step/upload hooks EditorWindow overrides.

EditorWindow adds the debugger: it discovers toolchains from XML files, builds the right debugger subclass per type, uploads firmware, and implements run/step/step-over/pause/reset/stop over the simulated CPU, showing the current line and cycle count in the output panel.
Declares the bebugState_t enum (DBG_STOPPED/PAUSED/STEPING/RUNNING), the compiler registry maps and the debugger lifecycle API.

Highlighter is a data-driven syntax highlighter: it parses a .syntax file with a 'rules:' header, -style: colour definitions and either word lists or regexes, supports multiline comment blocks via setCurrentBlockState, and prefers a _dark.syntax variant when the dark theme is active.
Declares Highlighter's HighlightRule struct and the four rule vectors (file, object, member, extra types).
scrollWidget paints breakpoint, search-hit, error and warning markers directly onto the editor's scrollbar, mapping line numbers to scrollbar pixels from the block count.
Declares scrollWidget, a QScrollBar that keeps a back-pointer to its CodeEditor.
FileBrowser is the file tree: it navigates the filesystem, opens .sim1/.sim2 files as circuits and everything else in the editor, opens items externally via QDesktopServices and toggles hidden files.
Declares FileBrowser over QTreeView with setPath/searchFiles and the open/cdUp/bookmark slots.
FileWidget is the sidebar: a bookmark list plus a path bar over the FileBrowser, with fixed entries (FileSystem, Home, User Data, Settings, Last Project) and bookmarks persisted in a QSettings array.
Declares FileWidget's bookmark list, the path line edit and the search slot that is currently a no-op.
JoystickWidget renders and tracks an analogue joystick, mapping the knob offset to two 0..1000 axes and snapping back to centre on release.
Declares JoystickWidget's setupWidget(size), getPos()/changed() and the mouse handling it installs as an event filter.
HeaderWidget is the Name/Type/Value header row above the watch list; it is a plain label trio with no logic beyond sizing to the font scale.
Declares HeaderWidget over ui_headerwidget.h with only setLabelVal-style setters.
Designer form: three QLabels (nameLabel, typeLabel, valueLine) in a row (read via widget inventory).
MCUMonitor is the MCU debug window: it stacks a Watch tab, a RAM watch table and RAM/Flash/EEPROM memory tables, paints the STATUS register bits and PC, and pushes edits back into the processor.
Declares MCUMonitor's tab members and the three dataChanged slots that write RAM, flash and EEPROM back.
Designer form: a QTabWidget plus byte/jump radio buttons (read via widget inventory).

MemData loads and saves memory images: a .data comma list, Intel HEX (with checksum verification and extended segment/linear address records) and raw binary, plus the string encoding used to persist a memory blob in a component property.
Declares MemData's static load/save entry points per format and the showTable() hook that opens the memory table window.
MemTable is the hex+ASCII memory viewer/editor: it edits cells in place (hex column and ASCII column), pauses the simulation while editing, and can save/load the whole table.
Declares MemTable's dataChanged signal, byte/word ratio handling and the cell address helpers.
Designer form: one QTableWidget for the hex dump plus save/load context actions (read via widget inventory).

RamTable is the symbol watch table: it resolves names to addresses, decodes 8/16/32-bit and float values from RAM, expands array variables into their elements, and saves/loads the watch list as a .vst file.
Declares RamTable's register/variable models, the watchList hash and the debugger back-pointer used for array types.
Designer form: a splitter holding a register list, a variable list and a four-column value table (read via widget inventory).
ValLabelWidget is the compact (proxy-embedded) variant of the value row: fixed-size labels instead of a line edit, used when the watcher is drawn on the canvas.
Declares ValLabelWidget over ui_vallabelwidget.h with the same name/type/value API as ValueWidget.
Designer form: three QLabels (name, value, type) (read via widget inventory).
ValueWidget is the full-size watch row: it reads the value from the Watched core each step and formats 8/16-bit values as dec/hex/bin.
Declares ValueWidget over ui_valuewidget.h with setValueDbl/setValueInt/setValueStr.
Designer form: name and type QLabels plus a read-only QLineEdit for the value (read via widget inventory).
Watched is the tiny interface a CPU implements so the GUI can watch it; createWatcher() lazily builds the Watcher panel.
Declares Watched's virtual command()/getDblReg()/getIntReg()/getStrReg() hooks and the Watcher owner pointer.

Watcher is the register/variable watch panel: it lists registers and variables, lets the user double-click to add live values, embeds itself in the canvas as a draggable proxy widget, and can host a Console.
Declares Watcher's two item models, the type/unit tables and the value-widget map, plus the proxy-widget mode.
Designer form: a splitter with a register list, a variable list and a valuesWidget container (read via widget inventory).

OutPanelText is the shared output log: it buffers text and flushes it once per simulation step, caps the document at 1000 blocks (and 100000 chars), and syntax-highlights paths, numbers, SUCCESS/WARNING/ERROR and SENT: markers.
Declares OutPanelText (an Updatable QPlainTextEdit) and the OutHighlighter rule table.
Template BoolProp<Comp> binds a boolean component property to a getter/setter member pointer pair and converts it to and from the strings true/false used in the file format.
BoolVal renders a boolean property as a single check box whose caption is the property caption; changes go through prepareChange/saveChanges so they land in the undo stack.
Declares BoolVal over ui_boolval.h and PropVal with the on_trueVal_toggled slot.
Designer form: one QCheckBox named trueVal (read via widget inventory).
ColorVal shows the colour as a swatch in a read-only field and opens a non-native QColorDialog on click, writing the colour name back to the component.
Declares ColorVal over ui_colorval.h with an event filter that turns a click on the swatch into a colour dialog.
Designer form: a caption QLabel, a QLineEdit swatch and a showVal radio button (read via widget inventory).
ComProperty is the base of every property: it stores name/caption/unit/type/flags and defaults to a string-valued property whose toString() is the raw value.
Declares ComProperty and the propFlags enum (propHidden, propNoCopy) that control visibility in the dialog and copying into subcircuits.
Template DoubProp<Comp> binds a double component property and overrides setVal()/getValue() to call the component's setter/getter.
DSpinBox is a numeric field that evaluates what you type as an arithmetic expression using the AngelScript engine, returning NaN (and thus Invalid) for anything that does not evaluate.
Declares DSpinBox with a static AngelScript engine and valueFromText/textFromValue/validate overrides.
EnumVal renders an enumeration property from a 'value1,value2;Label1,Label2' unit string, and supports updating the option list at runtime (used for the Arduino board list).
Declares EnumVal over ui_enumval.h with setEnums() and the m_enums value list.
Designer form: caption QLabel, a QComboBox value box and a showVal radio button (read via widget inventory).
Template IntProp<Comp> binds an integer component property to its getter/setter pair.
LabelVal is the plain caption row used to introduce groups of properties inside the dialog.
Declares LabelVal over ui_labelval.h with a single setLabelVal() call.
Designer form: one QLabel named label (read via widget inventory).
NumProp is the shared numeric-property codec: it splits 'value unit' strings, applies the SI multiplier for the unit and renders the value back with its unit.
Declares NumProp with the abstract setVal(double) that the typed Int/Doub subclasses implement.
NumVal renders a numeric property with a value box, a unit combo box (multipliers for ints, multipliers plus dividers for doubles) and a 'show value on canvas' toggle.
Declares NumVal over ui_numval.h with getValWithUnit() and the m_useMult flag.
Designer form: caption QLabel, a DSpinBox value box, a unit QComboBox, a unit spacer and a showVal radio button (read via widget inventory).
PathVal edits a file or directory property, resolving the browse dialog relative to the current circuit's folder and appending a separator for directories.
Declares PathVal over ui_pathval.h with the m_isFile flag that selects file vs directory dialog.
Designer form: caption QLabel, a QLineEdit value and a setPathButton (read via widget inventory).
Template PointProp<Comp> binds a QPointF component property and encodes it as 'x,y'.

PropDialog builds the whole property editor at runtime: it walks the component's propGroups, skips hidden groups and properties, disables no-copy properties on a subcircuit's main component, and instantiates the right PropVal widget for each property type.
Declares PropDialog's showProp/enableProp/updtValues API and the list of PropVal widgets it owns.
Designer form: a type label, help button, component label box with a show-id check box, a tabList and a helpText pane (read via widget inventory).

proputils holds the two parsers the whole file format rests on: parseXmlProps splits an <item name="value" .../> line into name/value pairs, and parseProps/parseProp do the same for the older ';' separated form.
Declares propStr_t (name/value pair) and the parseXmlProps/parseProps/parseProp helpers plus point encode/decode.
PropVal is the base of every property widget: prepareChange() opens an undo step and records the old value, and saveChanges() registers the property change with the Circuit's undo stack.
Declares PropVal's setup/updtValues virtuals and the unit divider/multiplier helpers used by the numeric widgets.
Template ScriptProp<Comp> binds a property whose value is produced by the component itself (the getter receives the property object and returns a string).
Template StrProp<Comp> binds a plain string component property to a getter/setter pair.
StrVal renders a string property as a caption plus a line edit; the value is committed on editingFinished.
Declares StrVal over ui_strval.h with the on_value_editingFinished slot.
Designer form: caption QLabel and a QLineEdit value (read via widget inventory).
TextVal renders a multi-line text property and decodes the XML entities the file format escapes (newlines, quotes, =, <, >) on load.
Declares TextVal over ui_textval.h; the script-evaluation feature is commented out and updatValue() is a FIXME no-op.
Designer form: one QTextEdit named textBox (read via widget inventory).
Console is the scripted CPU console: it buffers output and flushes it once per simulation step, and forwards a typed command line to the Watched core when Enter is pressed.
Declares Console as an Updatable QPlainTextEdit with the command/buffer state and the empty context menu.
SerialMonitor is the UART monitor: it shows incoming bytes and outgoing bytes in two read-only panels, formats each byte as ASCII/HEX/DEC/OCT/BIN, and can pause the display.
Declares SerialMonitor's two OutPanelText panels, the print mode and the paused flag.
Designer form: a pause tool button, a print-mode combo box, text and value send fields with an add-CR check box and clear buttons for both panels (read via widget inventory).
Terminal is the newer bidirectional byte terminal: it sends ASCII or numeric bytes in a chosen base, renders received bytes in a chosen base, and can load a file to send or save the received log.
Declares Terminal's sendBytes/closed signals and the received(uint8_t) slot.
Designer form: a splitter with a receive QTextEdit and a send panel (input QPlainTextEdit, send/clear/load buttons, base combo boxes) (read via widget inventory).
SourceWidget is a DialWidget with an extra push button appended under the knob (used by the signal-source component).
Declares SourceWidget as a DialWidget subclass exposing its CustomButton as a public member.

BatchTest is the repo's regression harness: it walks a folder tree for .sim1/.sim2 circuits, loads and simulates each one, waits for the in-circuit test units to report, and prints the list of failed circuits.
Declares BatchTest's static API: doBatchTest(folder), the per-component addTestUnit/testCompleted hooks and the failed-test list.

ThemeManager holds the light/dark palettes and four canvas colours; getColorPtr returns a pointer into a vector that is rewritten in place on a theme change, so every painted component picks up the new colour without re-registering.
Declares the Theme enum and ThemeManager's colour vector, palette and icon helpers.
UpDoButton is a 6x6 painted stepper button (red up triangle, blue down triangle) used by the memory-table spin controls.
Declares UpDoButton as a QToolButton with a precomputed triangle QPainterPath.
